verdict.rationale: The CLI documents `skills init [name]` to scaffold a new SKILL.md template, and the agentskills.io spec defines the required YAML frontmatter, optional fields, bundled resources, and a `skills-ref validate` step, so an agent has a template, spec, and validator to follow. A `skill-creator` meta-skill is also installable from vercel-labs/agent-skills, though it is only named. Missing for 10: any description of what the skill-creator meta-skill does, a documented packaging/publishing step beyond pushing to a git repo that `skills add` can consume, and hands-on or independent evidence of an agent authoring a skill end to end.
